superseded_reason: The second independent review found K-01 dependency protection incomplete and introduced a false positive on src/requirements.py; see fix-pass-2.json for the correction and current gate status.

findings_closed.finding: Proposal budgets were not strict limits: an exhausted token budget permitted another call and a blocking proposer retained control past its deadline.
findings_closed.fix: Token budget is checked before every batch after the first exhausted call. Proposer calls are bounded by the total-run deadline and results arriving after the deadline are never accepted.

findings_closed.finding: Parent/child normalisation paths were accepted and could hide nested differences.
findings_closed.fix: Prefix-related paths are refused in either order. Dropping a dict/list container is refused; drop is restricted to scalar leaves.

findings_closed.finding: Rule-trace validation accepted contradictory verified coverage, empty/malformed citations, missing review identity and impossible counts.
findings_closed.fix: Authenticated review records are required at build time. Validation now requires bounded source citations, valid digests and line ranges, state/review/digest agreement, phase and case consistency, recomputed reviewed/executed/failed/lexical counts, non-contradictory orphan and missing-evidence lists, and complete rows for verified coverage.

findings_closed.finding: requirements.txt was absent from the denied file set and was accepted by both a proposal and an allowed_paths contract.
findings_closed.fix: Dependency/build manifests and their common prefixed variants are refused by the same helper in proposal validation and contract allowed-path validation.

findings_closed.finding: Mutant controls sampled only the first 12 cases and could still report verified coverage; receipt validation did not reject contradictory detection outcomes or missing evidence under verified coverage.
findings_closed.fix: Sampling above the cap now records a missing-evidence note and cannot verify coverage. Receipt validation recomputes counts, checks detection/outcome agreement and rejects verified coverage with missing evidence.

gate.validator: hermes plugins validate /source --json: ok true, warnings empty

honest_limits: The deadline wrapper stops the engine waiting and refuses late results, but Python cannot forcibly terminate arbitrary blocking proposer code. A daemon worker may be abandoned; no late output is accepted.
Trace validation checks citation shape and internal consistency, not source-file bytes or a review store signature; the public trace is not an execution receipt.
These are fixture/engine checks. No live provider, real-project execution, dependency resolution, install, deploy, publish or point 4 release qualification is claimed.
Point 4 remains HOLD pending the separate owner decision.
